title_t4: Pre-registered demand event study, CBD vs donut control: mean coefficient +3.5% in 2023, -12.8% in 2024, -47.2% after congestion pricing (pre-trend test p = 4e-20)
title_t4b: CBD zones: median post/pre change in weekly pickups -5.6% relative to the control group's aggregate change
title_t4c: Pre-registered demand DiD is negative in 15 of 15 trip subsets (same design, same pre-trend caveat); within-CBD speed estimates are positive in 8 of 8 hour bands and distance terciles
title_t4d: After the policy, CBD pickups averaged +2.0% against the frozen forecast, while the event-study paths say -47.2% (pre-registered) and -11.3% (volume-weighted)
title_t4e: Permutation placebos: demand estimate -0.505 lies beyond 100% of 500 placebos (MDE 0.101); speed estimate +0.019: 6.4% of placebos as large (MDE 0.028)
title_t4f: Within-CBD taxi trips: speed +1.9% [+0.3%, +3.6%], duration -2.4% (pre-registered DiD), but the monthly gap to the control is seasonal (pre-trend test p = 1e-32)
